The desk combines AI signals with manual control. Newcomers can start on the practice account, fund US$250 when ready, and trade 12 assets through the partner broker.
Our method is a desk review: no funded account, no trades. We read the published material in full, including unfilled placeholders and contradictions, and scored five fixed dimensions.
whatItClaims: Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
whatWeChecked: The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Enter your name, email, phone and country, then confirm through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Send the US$250 starting deposit through one of the accepted methods.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set the risk parameters, decide between automatic and manual, and practise on the demo account.

pros: Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
redFlags: The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.
Payout promises with no processing detail.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: Where is Bull Run Depot restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: Is Bull Run Depot safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

bottomLine: The service behind the marketing looks functional, and a careful user can use it without stepping on the fine print.
The final score lands at 4.6 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
